purpose: Continue the offline historical engine with one complete-library unsupervised redundancy-balancing mechanism that is distinct from deterministic feature-equal consensus, fitted return weights, marginal PAVA calibration and tree interactions.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_140_numeric_library_positive_correlation_component_balanced_consensus
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Training-only daily cross-sectional rank correlations define positive-redundancy connected components at the already established 0.8 near-duplicate boundary. Every factor remains present; factors are averaged within components and components are then averaged equally. This asks whether preventing large families of similar factors from dominating improves portability without using a return target.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_minimum_variance_or_risk_parity_weights
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Covariance estimator, shrinkage, objective, constraints and solver tolerance create a broad optimization family rather than one auditable redundancy rule.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_pca_or_latent_component_consensus
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Component count and sign orientation introduce multiplicity, while later components can assign negative directions and silently discard most of the frozen library.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_return_weighted_cluster_or_supervised_ensemble
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Using IC, returns or survivor outcomes to choose clusters or cluster weights would refresh the Campaign102 fitted-weight family after exposure.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: campaign133_pava_or_campaign132_tree_stack
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Policies v159 and v160 make both model families terminal and forbid retry, reparameterization, stacking or rescue.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: complete_library_trimmed_quantile_product_or_rank_vote_refresh
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Arithmetic rank consensus, lower-quartile consensus, geometric/harmonic/minimum aggregators and directional breadth have already been consumed; changing their threshold or order statistic after results is an operator refresh.

selected_family.training_only_pair_statistic: For each feature pair and each contained training signal session with at least 50 jointly finite names, compute average-tie Spearman correlation; retain the median across sessions only when at least 100 sessions are available.
selected_family.graph_edge: Create an undirected edge exactly when the finite median daily Spearman correlation is greater than or equal to +0.8. Negative correlation never creates a redundancy edge.
selected_family.component_rule: Use deterministic undirected connected components; order components by their smallest frozen feature index and order members by frozen feature index.
selected_family.row_support: Require at least 105 finite raw components, then fill each missing component with 0.5.
selected_family.within_component_score: Arithmetic mean of every filled favorable percentile in that component.
selected_family.final_score: Arithmetic mean of all component scores, so every component has equal total weight and every source factor remains present with positive weight 1/(component_count*component_size).
